analysis: physical I-to-V on Experiment 16 Architecture I fabric
fairness: Frozen Experiment 9 weights. No Python output correction. TIA closed-loop A/(A+1) is left uncompensated. Architecture I is reproduced from Experiment 16, not overwritten. V_sum is measured in SPICE. Not layout. Not foundry PCM.

I.title: Experiment 16 Architecture I (current dump onto R_IV)
I.iv_topology: 0 V voltage source summing node. Behavioral I dump onto physical R_IV. Leftover copy is the dump.

A.title: feedback resistor TIA
A.iv_topology: Inverting TIA. Vout = I * Rf * A/(A+1). Summing node held by the amplifier, not by a 0 V source. Rf = 1/G_WEIGHT.

B.title: ratiometric TIA (Rf * R2/R1)
B.iv_topology: Inverting TIA then passive invert. Vout = I * Rf * (R2/R1) * closed-loop residuals. Common resistor shift cancels.

C.title: current-mode ReLU then TIA
C.iv_topology: Hidden: I_y = max(0, I_sum) in SPICE, then TIA. Output: feedback TIA. Current-domain ReLU is a B-source.

I.title: Experiment 16 Architecture I (current dump onto R_IV)
I.iv_topology: 0 V voltage source summing node. Behavioral I dump onto physical R_IV. Leftover copy is the dump.

nominal.active_note: Behavioral controlled sources, not transistors. leftover_current_copies = I dumps + current-mode ReLU B-sources. TIA / invert op-amps set resistor-ratio loops.
nominal.energy_note: I_rel = SigmaG * 1 V is a relative signal-path metric. Not board power. Behavioral sources have no Iq.

current_cost.label: relative physical current cost
current_cost.note: I_rel = SigmaG * V_rep with V_rep=1 V. This is a relative conductance-derived metric, not measured board power. SPICE source current is the sum of |I| through Vin* and Vref at one representative operating point.

summary.remaining_ideal_block: TIA open-loop VCVS/B-source (resistor Rf sets the gain; the amplifier is still a controlled source enforcing virtual ground)

device_preview.reason: ngspice example MOS / CMOS cards exist under C:\\ngspice\\examples but they are not a characterized drop-in summing-node TIA. Wiring them into Network A would invent bias and device sizing. No project device library.
